title: TypeOpCallother get*Local caller closure: PcodeOp -> Architecture-owned UserOpManage descriptor metadata (DatatypeUserOp void*/void*/void*/int4 and slot-minus-one mapping) or TypeOp base canonical TYPE_UNKNOWN fallback, observed at the PcodeOp level and through Varnode::getLocalType on both the def and reader sides
status_note: Production commit 5cba7550 wires the A48-located caller closure: src/varnode.rs op_output_type_local/op_input_type_local gain the CPUI_CALLOTHER arm (typeop.cc:855-873) and get_local_type plus both dispatch helpers gain the userops Option<&Arc<RwLock<UserOpManage>>> thread (the tlst->getArch()->userops edge; a TypeFactory arch backlink was rejected because Architecture::ensure_types installs the process-canonical TypeFactory::shared_default() singleton and set_types runs before the Architecture is Arc-wrapped). The locked Ghidra 12.0.4 oracle and the frozen Rugra snapshot were each executed twice with deterministic stdout/stderr. Both sides produced 72 records / 2495 bytes with identical sha256 and empty stderr; the bilateral byte diff is empty (exit 0). All 13 cases match: memcpy closure def/direct/reader (registered void* through registerBuiltin(BUILTIN_MEMCPY)), input slots 1/2 (void*), slot 3 (int4), slot 0 (the CALLOTHER index constant, xunknown4 through the base default), slot 4 (past the fixed inputs, xunknown1), and the metadataless UnspecializedPcodeOp closure (def/direct/reader and both input slots all canonical xunknown fallback).

representation.ghidra: Every observation runs against the real Architecture-owned userops table; the memcpy descriptor is created by the production registerBuiltin(BUILTIN_MEMCPY) (out=void*, in0..1=void*, in2=int4 from glb->types); the metadataless descriptor is an UnspecializedPcodeOp registered through the unmodified private registerOp body at the first free slot past the 1756 x86-64 SLEIGH basicops (registerOp does not take ownership on the exception paths; the probe deletes the candidate itself).
representation.rugra: Every observation calls the production get_local_type(block_up, type_factory, userops) / pub op_output_type_local / op_input_type_local entry points with the Architecture-owned userops handle (Architecture::set_userops; the Option thread stands in for Ghidra's tlst->getArch()->userops edge); the memcpy descriptor is created by register_builtin_with_local_types(BUILTIN_MEMCPY, void*, [void*, void*, int4]) with canonical factory Arcs and the metadataless descriptor by register_op (fresh manager, auto index 0); the resolved index values differ between sides and are never projected — the closure behavior is index-independent.

decisive_semantics.references_and_outputs: TypeOpCallother::get*Local return borrowed factory-canonical Datatype* pointers; the fixture compares pointer/Arc identity against the same factory getters Ghidra's registerBuiltin uses (void*, int4, xunknown1/2/4). The userOp descriptor reference is queried fresh and never held across calls; no out-parameters exist on the TypeOp path (blockup is a Varnode::getLocalType concern only and stays 0 in every closure case).
decisive_semantics.loop_bounds_and_order: No loops in the closure itself: in(0) is read exactly once per query, its offset truncated to the getOp(uint4) 32-bit domain; slot passes through unchanged to the descriptor virtual. The reader-side observations rely on the single-descendant walk of Varnode::getLocalType (varnode.cc:921) in addDescend insertion order — one reader each, so order cannot vary.
decisive_semantics.counters_and_accumulators: DatatypeUserOp::getInputLocal performs exactly one slot -= 1 before the bounds check (userop.cc:79); builtin_memcpy's inTypes has exactly 3 entries (null-compaction in the constructor, userop.cc:60-67), so slots 0 and 4 miss and slots 1-3 hit. No other counters exist.
decisive_semantics.sort_and_comparison_keys: No sorting anywhere in the closure; the only comparison is the res != null binary gate selecting between descriptor metadata and the TypeOp base default (typeop.cc:860-862/870-872). Descriptor lookup keys are the truncated CALLOTHER index (exact integer match, useroplist bounds then builtinmap, userop.cc:408-415) and nothing else.
